correctness.rationale: Under the stated descendant condition for coalitions of at most two, a violation requires exactly a forbidden unordered triple of distinct ternary 3-words with one descendant of the others. Independent generation of the entire 27-word hypergraph yielded exactly 972 forbidden triples. A fresh increasing-index bit-set search enumerated ALL size-nine and size-ten valid subsets (pruning solely forbidden triples and insufficient remaining candidates): zero size-ten sets and exactly 12 size-nine sets, after 2,340 search nodes. For every maximum, all three pair-coordinate projections have nine distinct pairs, so each code is the graph of a 3×3 Latin square. Direct enumeration of Latin squares of order three gives 12 and the same equality codebooks. Independent coordinate/symbol relabeling acts transitively on Latin squares of order3: the group has (3!)^3·3!=1296 elements, orbit 12, stabilizer 1296/12=108, consistent with inspected full finite verifier. The bound |C|≤9 is also known from separating hash theory; the new claim is equality classification. No claim for larger alphabets or n≠3.
